boundary.city.query: geospatial export GeoJSON (spec 原定 ewy2-6yfk Map 版端点故障，用同源 tabular 版)

boundary.official_centerlines.substitution_reason: data.cityofchicago.org 6imu-meau geospatial export returns empty FeatureCollection/503 and SoQL rows return 503 persistently (tested 2026-09-07, ~20 attempts over 30 min); TIGER ROADS used as official centerline reference for CPD-observability mask

census.acs5_tracts.query: ACS 2020 5-year B01003_001E, all IL tracts (data.census.gov public endpoint; api.census.gov now requires key)

query.$where: created_date in [2020-12-01,2025-01-01) AND sr_type IN (<26 mapped types, see raw/311/sr_type_inventory.json>)

query.$select: dig_ticket_, min(requestdate) AS req_min, min(digdate) AS dig_min, max(expirationdate) AS exp_max, max(latitude) AS lat_max, max(longitude) AS lon_max, count(*) AS n_notices
query.$where: requestdate in [2020-12-01, 2025-01-01) by WEEK slices, keyset pagination on dig_ticket_, 6 workers

dig_tickets.aggregation: server-side group by dig_ticket_ per week (min/min/max/max/max/count); coordinate constancy verified in qa/dig_ticket_coord_check.json; cross-slice tickets re-aggregated client-side in build_dynamic

traffic_tracker.query: daily slices: segment_id group-by (avg speed, sum bus/message counts), 8 workers

query.pattern: date_extract_y/m/d(trip_start_timestamp) x community_area x count(*), per dataset x WEEK x direction; last 5 weeks via daily slices (proxy drops long-idle connections)
